customManagers.description: The lint job installs golangci-lint from a version pin inside a run script, which no built-in manager sees.

packageRules.description: The AWS SDK ships ~35 separately versioned modules that release in lockstep. Ungrouped, they would never drain at prConcurrentLimit 1.

The workflows' go-version inputs (depName `go`), .tool-versions (depName `golang`) and the golangci-lint pin all track the same toolchain; bump them in one PR. golangci-lint especially cannot lag: it type-checks through a vendored x/tools that only reads export data from Go releases it already knows about.
